programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Renovations on Family Getaway in Virginia Beach
programs.desc: Having spent their youth enjoying all that Virginia Beach has to offer, a couple from Richmond is searching the beach for a retreat the whole family can enjoy. They're hoping to find a condo with ocean views that they can renovate into a coastal getaway.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The Barnwood Builders save a barn that once housed mules in the iron-mining boomtown of Low Moor, VA; as they work, they find evidence of the barn's industrial past; Mark visits a timber frame that's been converted into a gorgeous wedding venue.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: Mark Bowe and the guys sit down to talk about cabins and barns; with special guests, never-before-seen footage and outtakes; Mark also talks about his new house, and the guys choose their favorite jobs from the last few years.

programs.title: Salvage Dawgs
programs.desc: The crew members salvage items from the crumbling Pickle Mansion in Knoxville, Tenn.; the main items of interest are a copper frieze and columns.

programs.title: Salvage Dawgs
programs.desc: In Quakertown, Pa., the crew members seek to reclaim items from an old mine master's house, and they are surprised to find much of the house picked over before they arrive.

programs.title: Salvage Dawgs
programs.desc: The team travels to Free Will House in Huntington, W. Va., where they salvage a bathtub, a sitz bath and kitchen cabinets; Ted and Mike buy a butter churn; Tay and Mike build a wall TV shutter console in the shop.
